criteria.name: speech_pattern_fidelity
criteria.description: After the continuity pass, each character's lines are consistent with their speech_pattern from the bible. A character described as 'clipped and dry' doesn't deliver flowery monologues. A character described as 'formal, no contractions' doesn't use contractions. Test: pick the character whose bible speech_pattern is most specific. Does the revised dialogue actually reflect it?

criteria.name: correction_precision
criteria.description: Corrections fix specific inconsistency problems without rewriting lines that were already good. Over-correction (rewriting lines that didn't need it, changing the meaning of scenes) is penalized. Test: if corrections change lines that were already consistent with the character's voice, score 0–45.

criteria.name: consistency_across_scenes
criteria.description: A character's personality, knowledge, and emotional state are consistent across scenes. They don't forget information they learned earlier, don't contradict positions they established, don't shift tone arbitrarily between scenes.
